charges.name: Awaiting Customs Duty
charges.description: Customs authority has assessed import duties on the shipment.
charges.customerMessage: Import duties have been assessed on your shipment by the customs authority. Payment is required before your package can be released.

charges.name: Warehouse Storage Hold
charges.description: Shipment has exceeded the free storage window at the hub.
charges.customerMessage: Your shipment has exceeded the complimentary storage window at our bonded hub. Daily storage fees are accruing until the shipment is cleared or re-shipped.

charges.name: Customs Examination Fee
charges.description: Shipment selected for physical examination by customs authority.
charges.customerMessage: Your shipment has been selected for a physical examination by the customs authority. An examination handling fee applies before release.

charges.name: Re-delivery Charge
charges.description: A delivery attempt was unsuccessful and re-booking is required.
charges.customerMessage: A delivery attempt was made but could not be completed. A re-delivery fee applies to reschedule your delivery.

charges.name: Address Correction Fee
charges.description: Delivery address requires amendment before dispatch.
charges.customerMessage: The delivery address on your shipment is incomplete or incorrect. An address correction fee applies before your shipment can be dispatched.

charges.name: Express Hub Release
charges.description: Expedited release from hub or customs — bypasses standard queue.
charges.customerMessage: You have requested or been assigned an expedited release from the processing hub. This fee covers priority handling to bypass the standard clearance queue.

charges.name: Dangerous Goods Handling
charges.description: Shipment contains items requiring special handling per IATA/IMDG.
charges.customerMessage: Your shipment has been identified as containing goods that require special handling in compliance with IATA or IMDG regulations. A handling surcharge applies.

charges.name: Overweight Surcharge
charges.description: Shipment exceeds declared weight — additional per-kg charges apply.
charges.customerMessage: Your shipment has been found to exceed the declared weight at the hub. An additional per-kilogram surcharge applies for the excess weight.

charges.name: Held — Documents Required
charges.description: Missing customs documents are blocking clearance.
charges.customerMessage: Your shipment is on hold pending receipt of required documentation. An admin processing fee applies.

charges.name: Insurance Excess Payment
charges.description: Deductible payment required to process an active insurance claim.
charges.customerMessage: An insurance claim has been opened for your shipment. The policy excess payment is required to progress the claim.
